trajectory_summary: This is an efficient orphaned-flow (existing-solar, battery-add-on) call: legitimacy was established quickly, the rep correctly identified this wasn't a standard new-install lead and adapted the qualifier sequence, and the bill was captured live via text/screenshot before booking a next-day phone appointment. The real gap is informational, not structural — the customer twice named his specific technical requirement (EG4, 48V hybrid, non-Powerwall) and the rep never captured or reflected it, despite correctly deferring the technical conversation to the specialist.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; this call is best read as booked — a specific day (tomorrow) and time (2PM) were both confirmed by the customer at 05:52.
